Four merged pull requests since 2026-04-11 added or removed a line containing `configUrls` under `packages/tooling/openmrs`, newest first. Each PR number comes from the squash-commit subject on the default branch. The dates are those commits' dates, which I'm treating as the merge dates; I didn't check them against PR metadata.

1. **PR #1905**, merged 2026-10-02: "(docs) Rewrite the openmrs CLI README around how it's used". It adds `configUrls` to the README's example config and option table, and changes the `configUrls` mention in the CLI help text in `cli.ts` (the old list line was removed and a new one added). @file:{openmrs-esm-core::packages/tooling/openmrs/README.md:185-185} @file:{openmrs-esm-core::packages/tooling/openmrs/README.md:199-199} @file:{openmrs-esm-core::packages/tooling/openmrs/src/cli.ts:403-403}

2. **PR #1894**, merged 2026-09-28: "(BREAKING) Remove offline & rxjs support from framework". It drops `configUrls` from the `cli.ts` help text and from the `develop.ts` destructuring. It also touches the app shell's `configUrls` default in `esm-app-shell`, which is outside `packages/tooling/openmrs`, so it doesn't count toward the question.

3. **PR #1838**, merged 2026-08-07: "(feat) O3-5872: Add support for static compression of frontend". It rewrites the `cli.ts` help text that lists `configUrls`, adding `compress`.

4. **PR #1743**, merged 2026-04-15: "(BREAKING) Drop IMO and don't load arbitrary content in production mode". It changes `configUrls` in `packages/tooling/openmrs/src/utils/config.test.ts`. The lines at HEAD have moved since, so I cite the current `configUrls` line rather than the changed line numbers.

Scope: I searched the default branch (HEAD) and took it as the pinned head, since I found no other pin. Falkon's commit search can miss very large diffs, so this list may be incomplete.
